stories.title: Longtime Lions owner Martha Firestone Ford dies at age 101
stories.summary: Martha Firestone Ford, who served as the primary owner of the Lions from 2014 to 2020, has died at the age of 101, the team announced Tuesday night.
stories.detail: Martha Firestone Ford, who served as the primary owner of the Detroit Lions from 2014 to 2020, has died at the age of 101, the team announced Tuesday night. "Over more than six decades with the Detroit Lions, she was a loyal and constant fixture of the franchise, sharing in its history and traditions," the team said in a statement announcing her death. "She remained present with the team even this season, attending games with a devotion that endured throughout her life." No cause of death was given, although the team said she died at home surrounded by her family. Ford and her husband, William Clay Ford Sr., bought the Lions in 1963, and she took over his controlling interest in the team after his death in 2014. Although she seldom spoke to reporters or commented publicly on the direction of the franchise, her influence was felt. She was in charge of the team from 2014 until 2020, when she turned the Lions over to her daughter, Sheila Ford Hamp. Ford had since served as chair emeritus. The Lions made the playoffs in 2014 but lost seven of their first eight games the following season. In November 2015, the team fired its president and general manager in a midseason shake-up. stories.summary: "Tommy Cutlets" has been in this spot before.
stories.detail: “Tommy Cutlets” has been in this spot before. Former Giants quarterback Tommy DeVito, who became a household name in New York, is getting another chance to be in the pressure cooker as a starting signal caller . This time his task is to replace the injured Drake Maye, who suffered a fractured right fibula in the Patriots’ blowout loss to the Lions in Germany on Nov. 15. Maye is expected to be out at least six weeks, and though head coach Mike Vrabel hopes Maye can return at some point of the season, it’s no guarantee he will be ready to return for New England in 2026. Tommy DeVito, who is replacing injured starter Drake Maye, is all smiles as he talks to reporters during a news conference before the Patriots’ practice on Nov. 24, 2026, in Foxborough, Mass. stories.title: Broncos' Sean Payton: J.K. Dobbins suspended one game for detrimental conduct
stories.summary: The Broncos suspended running back J.K. Dobbins for one game for conduct detrimental to the team.
stories.detail: ENGLEWOOD, Colo. -- Denver Broncos coach Sean Payton said Tuesday that he has suspended running back J.K. Dobbins for Friday's game against the Pittsburgh Steelers due to "conduct detrimental.'' Dobbins will not practice or take part in any team activities this week. The Broncos (8-2) face the Steelers on Friday at Acrisure Stadium in Pittsburgh. "There is one team announcement, I'm not going to comment afterwards: I'm suspending J.K. Dobbins for this weekend's game, conduct detrimental, that's all I'm going to say about it,'' Payton said after Tuesday's practice. "Head coach's decision.'' Asked if he wanted to elaborate on any of the circumstances that surrounded the decision, Payton said no and added "think it's better that way.'' Dobbins was in the Broncos' facility earlier Tuesday and then left, multiple team sources said. Payton then told players of the suspension in the team's normally scheduled group meeting. Dobbins, in his second season with the team and a player Payton had called one of the "top priorities'' to re-sign this past offseason, had one carry, for no gain, in the Broncos' 38-24 victory Sunday over the Las Vegas Raiders . stories.summary: — Jayson Tatum scored 28 of his 41 points in the first half and the Boston Celtics snapped their four-game losing streak by beating the Washington Wizards 131-116 on Tuesday night.
stories.detail: WASHINGTON -- — Jayson Tatum scored 28 of his 41 points in the first half and the Boston Celtics snapped their four-game losing streak by beating the Washington Wizards 131-116 on Tuesday night. The Celtics made 10 3-pointers during a 46-point second quarter. That gave Boston an 80-49 lead at halftime, and although Washington cut the deficit to five with a spirited second-half effort, the Celtics held on. The Celtics remained unbeaten in NBA Cup play, and Washington is mathematically eliminated. Paul George scored 28 points for Boston, and Neemias Queta had 21. Anthony Davis had 33 points and 13 rebounds for the Wizards. Kyshawn George added 24 points and rookie AJ Dybantsa had 20 points, 11 rebounds and seven assists. Trae Young scored 17 points with 12 assists. Queta scored 13 points for Boston before Davis, the opposing big man, managed any. That helped the Celtics to a 34-28 lead after one quarter, and then the bottom fell out for the Wizards. Boston began the second quarter with a 14-3 run, and the Celtics later went on an 11-0 streak — with three 3-pointers by Tatum — to lead 70-38. Boston faces Atlanta on Friday night, with the winner finishing atop this NBA Cup group. Wash…

stories.summary: Paul George is in the midst of a career renaissance in his first season with the Boston Celtics. Kyshawn George learned the hard way Tuesday night.
stories.detail: Paul George is in the midst of a career renaissance in his first season with the Boston Celtics. Washington Wizards guard Kyshawn George learned the hard way Tuesday night. With the Celtics in control of their NBA Cup matchup in Washington, Paul sized up Kyshawn in isolation. He gained some separation with an arm extension on the perimeter, then crossed Kyshawn over as he drove to his right. Kyshawn did not stay with him. pic.twitter.com/7b33YgpVeG — Celtics Clips (@celticsclipss) November 25, 2026 Instead, Kyshawn fell on his backside on to the court and into the legs of his teammate, Anthony Davis. Paul picked up his dribble and waited a beat while shooting a glance at Kyshawn — just to make sure Kyshawn was watching. Only then did Paul pull up for a jumper from just inside the 3-point arc that sank through the net to extend Boston’s lead to 90-65. George, 36, entered Tuesday’s game doing an admirable job of making Celtics fans forget about Jaylen Brown, whom he was traded for. He’s the clear No. 2 option behind Jayson Tatum with averages of 19.9 points, 5.6 rebounds, 3.8 assists and 2.2 steals per game. stories.detail: ORLANDO, Fla. -- — Isaiah Joe had 21 points and Daniss Jenkins added 15 to spur the Detroit Pistons past the Orlando Magic 104-86 in an NBA Cup game on Tuesday night. With leading scorer Cade Cunningham out with a knee injury, Detroit also got 13 points from Ron Holland and improved to 2-1 in NBA Cup group play. The Pistons handed Orlando its first loss of the in-season tournament, preventing the Magic from clinching East Group A. Desmond Bane had 21 and Franz Wagner scored 20 for Orlando, which now must wait for Detroit, Brooklyn, Milwaukee and Toronto to finish the group stage before learning whether it has advanced to the knockout round. Joe, making his first start in a Pistons uniform after four seasons in Oklahoma City, scored 14 points in the second half. He made three consecutive 3-pointers in the fourth quarter to put the game out of reach. The Pistons built an 18-point lead in the third quarter and kept a healthy advantage throughout the second half. Detroit scored the game’s first eight points and, after allowing Orlando back in the game, took command in the second quarter. stories.detail: Stephen A. Smith raised some eyebrows last Wednesday when he called out the NBA for potentially letting the Lakers win a championship. Smith reveals Black NBA players have shared their support about his white player Lakers comments. ZUMAPRESS.com But even with the scrutiny, he’s also received support.
